Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner relied on a DuckDuckGo snippet and concluded Svensk Filmdatabas listed Gustaf Molander’s birthplace as Helsingborg, Sweden, without opening and verifying the actual SFdb page. This confused Helsingborg with Helsingfors and ignored corroborating sources (SBL, sv.wikipedia) indicating Helsingfors (Helsinki), leading toward the wrong birthplace.
